claims.claim: Nikon D810 DSLR Camera + 24-70mm Lens for Sale
claims.evidence: Witness report shows a Nikon DSLR body with a large attached lens, but the exact model number (D810) and the lens focal length (24-70mm) are not readable in the provided photo.

claims.claim: Clean and well-maintained Nikon D810 camera
claims.evidence: Witness notes used condition with no obvious cracks visible in the photo, but scratches/dents/wear on sensor and lens glass are not shown clearly.
Witness report explicitly shows visible Nikon branding on the camera body.

risks.risk: Exact camera model may not be D810 (model name/number not readable), which changes value significantly.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the camera model text/label (e.g., on the front/top/bottom plate) showing 'D810'.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown Nikon DSLR body (worst-case for value) with no confirmed model-specific premium.

risks.risk: Lens may not be the claimed 24-70mm (focal length/aperture not readable), and could be a different Nikon lens or third-party lens.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the lens nameplate/engraving showing the exact lens model and focal length (e.g., '24-70mm') and aperture.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unverified generic Nikon DSLR lens with unknown specs.

risks.risk: Functionality not confirmed (autofocus, shutter, buttons/ports, stabilization).
risks.proof: A short video clip showing autofocus working on a subject, live view focusing, and a quick playback of a taken photo (with on-screen shutter count if available).
risks.if_unproven: Price as 'untested' or 'not guaranteed working' until functionality is demonstrated.

risks.risk: Sensor and lens glass condition not fully shown (scratches, fungus, haze, dust).
risks.proof: Macro close-up photos of lens front element and rear element, plus a sensor dust/scratch check image (e.g., a test shot of a blank wall at high f-stop).
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case for optical/sensor wear (discounted for possible cleaning/repair needs).

risks.risk: Missing accessories (battery, charger, memory card, caps, hood, strap, manuals/box) can reduce usability and resale value.
risks.proof: A single laid-out photo showing every included item: battery model, charger, memory card, lens caps (front/rear), lens hood, strap, and any box/manuals.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming key accessories may be missing (worst-case for buyer readiness).

risks.risk: Potential scam/identity confusion: seller claims Canon while witness sees Nikon branding; could indicate misleading listing or wrong item.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the camera body branding and the exact model label, plus the lens branding, all matching the listing.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case due to mismatch risk (discount heavily until identity is confirmed).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the camera model label showing 'D810' (front/top/bottom plate).
Clear close-up photo of the lens engraving showing exact lens model and '24-70mm' (and aperture).
Video clip: autofocus working + live view focusing + quick capture and playback of a photo.
Macro close-ups of lens front and rear glass (and any visible fungus/haze/scratches).
Sensor check image (test shot of a blank wall at high f-stop) to reveal dust/scratches.
Photo of all included accessories laid out: battery, charger, memory card, front/rear caps, lens hood, strap, manuals/box.
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a Nikon DSLR body with an attached lens, but the exact D810 model and 24-70mm lens specs are not readable, and functionality/accessories are not shown. Also, the seller’s 'Canon' claim conflicts with the Nikon branding, so proof is needed before a reliable worst-case price.
